correctness.rationale: An exact signed chain-Lefschetz formula turns every fixed matching into a weighted edge-orbit independence sum. A six-periodic recurrence handles rotations, fixed-spoke orbit cases handle all reflections, and the known wheel homology concentration converts Lefschetz numbers to individual homology characters. The divisor-sum and character-averaging proof establishes the mod-12 invariant statement for all n. Two independent finite evaluators agree for every element of D_n, n=3..14, and check integral character averages through n=204; finite tests do not replace the recurrence proof.
